info.title: InventoryX.Presentation
info.x-inventoryx-concurrency: Mutable aggregates return an ETag response header; mutations that race must send If-Match with the latest ETag.

post.description: Rotate access/refresh tokens. Body `{ refreshToken }` is optional when the httpOnly `inventoryx_refresh` cookie is present. Sets/rotates cookies on success; clears `inventoryx_refresh` and `inventoryx_session` on 400/401/403.

post.x-inventoryx-live-only-reason: PIN exchange requires an authenticated device session and live credential verification.

get.x-inventoryx-live-only-reason: Availability outside the cached register snapshot requires a live stock query.
